records.title: Espresso
records.text: Espresso is pressure-extracted intensity: 18g in, 36g out, 25-30 seconds. The base of milk drinks.

records.title: Americano
records.text: Americano is espresso lengthened with hot water: clean and strong.

records.title: Cappuccino
records.text: Cappuccino is the classic thirds: dry foam cap, drinkable art.

records.title: Latte
records.text: Latte is the milky canvas: espresso softened under steamed milk.

records.title: Flat white
records.text: Flat white is the Australian intense latte: less foam, more coffee punch.

records.title: Macchiato
records.text: Macchiato is espresso stained with foam: small and strong.

records.title: Cortado
records.text: Cortado is the Spanish equal-parts: no foam, just balance.

records.title: Mocha
records.text: Mocha is dessert coffee: espresso meets chocolate.

records.title: Cold brew
records.text: Cold brew steeps coarse grounds cold for 12-24 hours: smooth, sweet, low acid.

records.title: Iced coffee
records.text: Iced coffee is hot coffee flash-chilled: brew strong over ice.

records.title: Pour over (V60)
records.text: Pour over is the clarity method: spiral pours, paper filter, bright cups.

records.title: Chemex
records.text: Chemex thick filters make the cleanest cup: tea-like and sweet.

records.title: French press
records.text: French press is full immersion: heavy body, simple ritual.

records.title: AeroPress
records.text: AeroPress is the pressure hack: fast, forgiving, endlessly recipe-tweakable.

records.title: Moka pot
records.text: Moka pot is stovetop espresso-ish: strong, nostalgic, Italian mornings.

records.title: Turkish coffee
records.text: Turkish coffee boils powder-fine grounds in a cezve: intense, with grounds settling.

records.title: Espresso grind
records.text: Espresso grind is fine like table salt: too fine chokes, too coarse sours.

records.title: Filter grind
records.text: Drip grind is medium like sand.

records.title: French press grind
records.text: Press grind is coarse like breadcrumbs to avoid sludge.

records.title: Arabica beans
records.text: Arabica is the quality species: sweeter, more acidic, higher grown.

records.title: Robusta beans
records.text: Robusta is the strong species: more caffeine, more crema, harsher.

records.title: Light roast
records.text: Light roast keeps origin character: bright, tea-like.

records.title: Medium roast
records.text: Medium roast balances origin and caramel: the crowd-pleaser.

records.title: Dark roast
records.text: Dark roast is roast flavor forward: smoky, bold, low acid.

records.title: Bean storage
records.text: Store beans airtight, cool, dark — never the freezer for daily use. Buy whole, grind fresh.

records.title: Water for coffee
records.text: Water is 98 percent of coffee: filtered, 90-96 C, not distilled.

records.title: Caffeine content
records.text: Caffeine: espresso shot ~63mg, drip cup ~95mg, cold brew ~200mg. Light roasts edge darker by scoop.

records.title: Latte art basics
records.text: Latte art needs velvet microfoam and a steady pour: start high, finish low and close.

records.title: Dialing in espresso
records.text: Dial in: fix dose, adjust grind for 25-30 seconds. Sour means finer; bitter means coarser.

records.title: Decaf process
records.text: Swiss Water decaf uses water, not chemicals, keeping flavor closest to regular.
